{{Quote|They're proud, I mean, my mom is. I'm the first in my family to attend university, and I earned a scholarship. My father works at a fiber hive in Kescrat and doesn't really see the point of higher education.|Fennro Drogan|<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />}}
'''Kescrat''' was a location on the [[Colonies]] [[planet]] [[Ghorman]].<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" /> In [[6 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{EOAdate}}</ref> the [[Fennro Drogan's father|father]] of [[Fennro Drogan]] worked at a [[Unidentified fiber hive|fiber hive]] in Kescrat.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" /> That same [[standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Drogan mentioned Kescrat in relation to his father when discussing his life with [[Chemish Runazha]], an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[spy]] posing as a student at [[Palmo University]].<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kescrat was mentioned in [[Rebecca Roanhorse]]'s [[2026]] novel ''[[Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss]]'', the second book of the ''[[Star Wars: Reign of the Empire]]'' trilogy.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />
